summary: Tested 3 new features: brute-force login lockout (5-attempt/15-min window), recurring bookings (daily/weekly/weekday/validation), email-skip logging (Resend degrades gracefully), and Book Again UI flow. Added 10 new pytest cases under TestBruteForceLockout, TestRecurringBookings, TestEmailSkipLog. Final: 45 passed / 1 skipped / 2 failed (both are pre-existing cross-run data pollution on overlap/reject tests — not feature bugs). Frontend: recurring toggle+fields render & wire correctly; BookingForm correctly reads prefillStart/prefillEnd/title from URL query (confirmed via screenshot: title='TEST_From_URL', start=06/15 10:00, end=06/15 11:00).

minor.issue: test_create_overlap_rejected fails intermittently due to accumulated TEST_ booking data from prior runs colliding on same (day,hour,minute,second) slot. Test-only issue, not a product bug.

action_items: (LOW/test-hygiene) Add a teardown or DB-reset to clean TEST_ bookings; current high-entropy jitter (random hour+minute+second+microsecond) mitigates but does not eliminate collision risk for long-lived test runs.

(INFO) Frontend Book Again button click flow was NOT exercised end-to-end because employee test user has no past bookings. Prefill URL reading — which is the harder half of the feature — was verified directly. If end-to-end click coverage is required, seed a past booking or manually check-in a short booking before running the UI test.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.send_email uses asyncio.to_thread inside the request task; notify() fires asyncio.create_task(send_email) — confirm this is awaited/ detached cleanly so request latency isn't impacted. Currently services.notify wraps with create_task which is fire-and-forget. Good.
auth_routes._recent_failures: counts ALL failures within 15-min window until hitting a success row; correct for the 'reset on success' requirement.

routers/bookings_routes.create_recurring skips weekday weekends by advancing +1 and does NOT count that skip as an occurrence — matches requirement. However, when `pattern=weekday` starts on a weekend, it correctly rolls forward before counting. Good.

create_recurring commits ONCE at the end for all occurrences. If one booking in the middle raises an unexpected DB error, all prior additions may roll back. Consider per-occurrence try/except with rollback to savepoint for stronger isolation (low priority).

RecurringResult schema uses forward-ref 'BookingOut' but is defined before BookingOut in schemas.py — Pydantic v2 resolves it via model_rebuild() lazily; currently works but add `RecurringResult.model_rebuild()` explicitly for safety if schemas.py grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for new features (recurring UI + prefill URL read both verified)

seed_data_creation: None. High-entropy jitter (hour+min+sec+microsec random) used to avoid cross-run collision for new tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (brute-force lockout, recurring bookings, email-skip logging) plus Book Again prefill URL path are verified. Backend regression is clean except 2 cross-run pollution flakes (test_create_overlap_rejected, test_reject_flow) that are NOT feature bugs. Frontend 'Book Again' button click flow requires a past booking to fully exercise end-to-end; the URL-reading half is confirmed. LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5, LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES=15. RESEND_API_KEY intentionally empty -> [email-skip] log line confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.
